title: Launch of Tandem, a paid AI meal-planning app
subject: Tandem (the meal-planning app) and its launch
simulation_requirement: Predict how home cooks, nutrition professionals and tech media react during the first 48 hours after Tandem announces its launch at 12 EUR/month with a 7-day trial, which objections spread, and whether the pricing or the privacy policy becomes the main controversy.

entities.name: Tandem
entities.summary: Seed-stage startup launching an AI app that plans a week of meals from what is in your fridge, generates the shopping list and adapts to diets. 12 EUR/month after a 7-day trial; the app needs a photo of your fridge and access to purchase history.
facts: Privacy policy allows sharing anonymised purchase data with retail partners

initial_posts.content: Meet Tandem 🍳 Snap your fridge, get a week of meals and a shopping list that adapts to your diet. 7 days free, then 12€/month. Launching today!
Been testing @tandem for 2 weeks. It saved me 3 grocery runs and the recipes are actually good. Not perfect with leftovers yet. Code LUCA20 for 20% off.
